guidelines.label: Define clear strategic objectives
guidelines.detail: The work ties to a stated business objective, not just a screen.

guidelines.label: Evaluate competitive differentiation
guidelines.detail: How does this stand apart from alternatives in the market?

guidelines.label: Assess value proposition clarity
guidelines.detail: The value to the customer is explicit and defensible.

guidelines.label: Surface tradeoffs explicitly
guidelines.detail: Decisions name what is being optimized for and what is given up.

guidelines.label: Tie to measurable outcomes
guidelines.detail: Success is defined by a metric, not a vibe.

scoring.label: Strategic intent stated
scoring.description: Presenter framed the business objective up front.

scoring.label: High engagement
scoring.description: Decision-makers and stakeholders actively weighing in.

scoring.label: Evidence-based discussion
scoring.description: Arguments cite market, financial, or competitive evidence.

scoring.label: Actionable feedback
scoring.description: Each point resolves to a decision or a defined next analysis.

coachingCues.nudge: Ask which business objective this serves
Prompt the team to name the tradeoff being made
Ask for the competitive or financial evidence
